series.name: node_*
series.description: Upstream node_exporter host metrics (CPU, memory, disk, filesystem, network, load) under their upstream node_* names. Referenced as a family, not enumerated field-by-field. Host identity via the instance label, promoted from the rendered host label at scrape time.

series.name: container_*
series.description: Upstream cAdvisor per-container metrics under their upstream container_* names, present only on hosts that opt into cAdvisor. Referenced as a family, not enumerated field-by-field. Host/workload telemetry ONLY — never a service liveness signal (REQ-CONT-03).

series.name: pulse_deep_health
series.description: Gauge: the mapped JSON value for one responseMapping metric of one probed service. Emitted by the central deep-health prober; host/service self-emitted from the probe entry name.

series.name: pulse_deep_health_up
series.description: 1 = last probe succeeded, 0 = last probe failed. Fail-visibility signal for a probed service (REQ-PROBE-04).

series.name: pulse_deep_health_last_scrape_seconds
series.description: Unix seconds of the last SUCCESSFUL probe of the service. A stale value signals a silently failing probe target.

series.name: pulse_agent_up
series.description: 1 while the per-host agent is alive. An explicit per-host liveness signal, distinct from node_exporter's up (REQ-HB-01).

series.name: pulse_agent_build_info
series.description: Always 1; carries the agent build version in the version label (REQ-HB-02). The component label is the fixed value "agent".

series.name: pulse_backup_freshness_age_seconds
series.description: Gauge: seconds since the newest backup artifact of a service (issue #3). Emitted by a scalar command signal synthesized from a service's backup_freshness.command; service is baked, host is scrape-applied via the managed-linux-command-exporter job. The backup-freshness rule family selects this by {service}.

series.name: pulse_backup_freshness_up
series.description: 1 = the backup-age command ran this cycle, 0 = it failed/couldn't run. Fail-visibility for the delivered backup signal; missing data is NOT a healthy backup (REQ-BACKUP-03).

series.name: pulse_command_signal_up
series.description: 1 = an exposition-mode command signal ran and produced output this cycle, 0 = blind. The signal label is the estate-declared command_signals name; host is scrape-applied. A scalar signal instead emits its own declared up_metric (name in the estate config, not enumerated here).
